description: This file contains controller functions for user-related operations in a backend server, including user registration, login, profile management, appointment booking and cancellation, and payment processing via Razorpay and Stripe.

methods.name: registerUser
methods.description: Handles user registration, including validation, password hashing, and token generation.

methods.name: loginUser
methods.description: Handles user login by verifying email and password, returning a JWT token.

methods.name: getProfile
methods.description: Retrieves user profile data excluding password.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates user profile information, including optional image upload to Cloudinary.

methods.name: bookAppointment
methods.description: Books a new appointment with a doctor, updating slots and saving appointment data.

methods.name: cancelAppointment
methods.description: Cancels an existing appointment and releases the booked slot.

methods.name: listAppointment
methods.description: Lists all appointments for a specific user.

methods.name: paymentRazorpay
methods.description: Creates a Razorpay order for payment processing.

methods.name: verifyRazorpay
methods.description: Verifies Razorpay payment and updates appointment payment status.

methods.name: paymentStripe
methods.description: Creates a Stripe checkout session for payment.

methods.name: verifyStripe
methods.description: Verifies Stripe payment success and updates appointment payment status.
